title: Maps by Touch | Opening-week decisions
titleZh: 用觸覺讀地圖｜開展首週安排
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 | Program guide | Maps by Touch
The route kit contains raised maps that visitors can follow under a guide’s direction. Mount the maps on a portable floor stand (not on a countertop) unless the venue has a fixed mount. After a session, the maps must go into a flat, lockable drawer. A spare stand travels with every kit; storage does not.

The pocket card is a raised version of the key, with the route names in large print. Visitors may take it away, but it does not show the routes themselves. At a quiet session, visitors can follow the complete routes on their own, without spoken directions or commentary. In a quiet session, visitors still need to return the route maps before leaving.

Volunteer reports distinguish a broken map from a label that becomes unreadable in the room. If the visitor locates the same marker on a second copy under the same conditions, pull just the first copy for repair. If the marker is missed on both copies and the cause has not been identified, report the conditions and keep that observation separate from the repair count.

DOCUMENT 2 | Opening-week site log
Birch Hall: Fixed mount and deep display case on site. The case locks, but everything inside it hangs vertically. The stand from the kit will fit.

Cedar Library: No fixed mount. Confirmed space on the floor for the kit stand. A flat, lockable map drawer is reserved from the end of every session through the next morning.

Elm Center: Fixed mount and a lockable flat drawer. The drawer is occupied until the following week. The first event at this center is planned for this week.

At a trial, a guest could not find the station marker on map 3. Under the same lamp and using the same instructions, the guest found it on map 5. A second guest could not find the river marker on maps 4 or 6, even after moving closer to the lamp. We have not determined why.

Fir Annex: A flat, lockable drawer is available, but its fixed mount has been removed. A countertop is available; there is no clear floor space for the stand.

Hart Room: The lobby table and staffing for pocket-card pickup are confirmed through Saturday. Staff are still checking whether there is a flat drawer for the raised route maps.

DOCUMENT 3 | Email | Friday’s program
Irene will bring her cousin on Friday. Her cousin wants to explore an entire route independently and needs the room to be free of narration, but does not need a map to take away. The pocket cards for mailing are already packed. Please keep her on the guest list, even if preparing the quiet session adds work.

The revised pocket-card jacket fixes the spelling of Milford. It replaces the wrapper, not the raised card inside. We may send the cards that are already packed if the labels on the envelopes do not use the misspelling. I checked those envelopes this morning: all say ‘Milford.’ The full-size printed maps will instead be held until the printing shop certifies their separate correction.

The city calendar is for full-show listings, and a venue has to confirm all required equipment before we give it a listing. Use our noticeboard for a confirmed card pickup when the show is not confirmed; use ‘pocket cards only’ as the heading. Hart Room normally opens on Sundays, but do not advertise pickup for any day beyond the confirmed staffing period.
passageZh:
文件 1｜計畫指南｜用觸覺讀地圖
路線套件內有凸紋地圖，可由導覽員引導訪客循圖摸讀。除非場地有固定支架，否則請將地圖裝在便攜式落地支架上，不可改放檯面。活動結束後，地圖必須收進可上鎖的平放抽屜。每套都有隨附的備用支架，但不附收納設備。

口袋卡是觸覺版圖例，上面以大字印出路線名稱。訪客可以帶走，但卡片本身沒有畫出路線。靜音場次可自行摸讀完整路線，沒有語音指示或口頭解說。訪客在靜音場次離開前，同樣須歸還路線圖。

志工報告會區分地圖損壞和標記在活動空間裡變得難以辨認的情況。若訪客在同樣條件下能在第二份地圖上找到同一標記，只須送修第一份。若兩份都沒找到這個標記，且原因仍不明，請記下使用條件，但不要把這筆觀察算入送修件數。

文件 2｜開展首週場地紀錄
樺樹館：現場有固定支架和深型展示櫃。展示櫃可上鎖，但裡面的物品都要垂直吊掛。套件隨附的支架放得下。

雪松圖書館：沒有固定支架，已確認地面有地方放套件支架。每場活動結束後至隔天早上，都有預留可上鎖的平放地圖抽屜。

榆樹中心：有固定支架和可上鎖的平放抽屜。抽屜要到下一週才會空出。該中心原訂本週舉辦首場活動。

試用時，一名訪客在 3 號圖上找不到車站標記。他在同一盞燈下、依照相同指示，卻在 5 號圖上找到了。另一名訪客就算移近燈，也在 4 號和 6 號圖上都找不到河流標記。我們尚未確定原因。

冷杉分館：有可上鎖的平放抽屜，但固定支架已拆除。有檯面可用，地面沒有能放便攜支架的空位。

哈特室：大廳的口袋卡領取桌和負責人員已確認可用到週六。工作人員仍在查是否有能平放凸紋路線圖的抽屜。

文件 3｜電子郵件｜週五活動
艾琳週五會帶表親過來。她的表親想自己摸讀整條路線，需要現場沒有口頭解說，但不需要帶走地圖。郵寄用的口袋卡已經裝封。即使準備靜音場次會增加工作，也請讓她留在訪客名單上。

修訂後的口袋卡封套修正了 Milford 的拼字。這次換的是紙套，裡面的凸紋卡並沒有更換。如果已包好的信封標籤沒有拼錯，就可以寄出。我今早檢查過，那些信封全部拼成「Milford」。全尺寸印刷地圖要等印刷廠確認另一項修正後才會發出。

市府活動行事曆只刊登完整展覽；場地要先確認所需設備都已就緒，才能登上行事曆。若完整展覽尚未確認，但口袋卡領取已確認，請到我們自己的公告欄刊登，標題用「僅提供口袋卡」。哈特室通常週日會開放，但請勿宣傳在人員值班尚未確認的日期可領取。
